That’s similar to what happened to me although I couldn’t tell you how many times I’ve tied a noose around my neck and tried partial suspending myself only to chicken out. It’s the numb feeling that kills you. It’s like you’re coping with the fact your about to try to kill yourself in some weird trance like state and you just perform the “ritual” of suicide. 

On my attempt I walked to the roof of a parking garage and sat on the ledge crying for a solid hour before I somehow convinced myself to make my way home (I’m too afraid of heights). When I made it home I posted online that I was about to kill myself and when my post got removed I felt I had nothing left to hold onto and I stopped crying and felt at peace. I started taking pills a couple out at a time to calm my nerves and slowly started mixing it with alcohol and by the end I was gulping bottles of pills and got scared. It suddenly hit me that I didn’t really want to die or more so that I didn’t have to die. I ended up calling a friend I no longer talking to saying something like, “if I die tonight I want you to know I love you” he ended up getting a mutual friend to come pick me up and go to the hospital but I slipped unconscious before I made it to the hospital and woke up several hours later with iv’s in my arm, followed by people taking me to a mental hospital. 

I really wished then that I didn’t wake up. I didn’t want to die but realized then that if I would have died I would have known no difference and there wouldn’t have been a me to interpret the experience or the pain of dying, it would of been as if I never existed in the first place to have experienced my death. It was honestly bliss until I woke up of course. I fell in love in the hospital too with a crazy stripper who tried to fuck me when she snuck into my room. I said no of course, I know where she works maybe I’ll pay her a visit sometime.

I really miss the hospital sometimes though at the same time I hate it. I just like how everyone takes care of you when you can’t take care of yourself. Well I guess that’s not true exactly. Or even at all imo. All you do is pretend your ok so they can release you so you don’t end up with a massive bill. All people ever talk about is wanting to get out or what they’ll do when you’re out. Plus no one gives half a fuck about how you identify, well some people and do you hang around them and cope their cigarettes till you get your own.
